title: Hosted simulation of a bounded loop
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape binary machine with states indexed by $	ext{Fin}(n+1)$, and let $c$ be a configuration whose state is present. Let $d$ be a configuration of the compiled machine, initially at its live entry, representing $c$: the simulated input position and work tapes agree, the transition table is stored on the table tape, the output summary and unary state are stored on the summary tape, and both auxiliary heads are at cell $0$. Let $w$ be a binary word, let $ct: br	o	ext{Option}(	ext{Bool})$ and $cp ullet ullet ullet$ be a tape content and offset such that $ct(cp+p)$ stores the symbol of $w$ at every integer $p$ with $-1 ullet ullet ullet$ and $p ullet ullet ullet |w|$. Suppose $t$ is the natural number represented by the binary digits of $w$, and let the input head position of $c$ satisfy the virtual boundary-tag condition for a bit $b$. For any input-head position $p$ on an input $z$ and any output prefix, there are a time $T$, a simulated configuration $e$, a tape content $ct'$, and a boundary tag $b'$ such that $T ullet ullet ullet t(50(|	ext{tableBits}(M)|+1))+4t+2|w|+2$, and whenever the simulated machine has halted by time $t' ullet ullet ullet t$, $T ullet ullet ullet t'(50(|	ext{tableBits}(M)|+1))+4t'+2|w|$. The configuration $e$ represents the machine configuration after $t$ steps and has the same output as $d$; $ct'$ agrees with $ct$ outside the cells from $cp$ through $cp+|w|-1$, and $e$ satisfies the virtual boundary-tag condition for $b'$. After exactly $T$ steps, the hosted machine is the virtual-host configuration of the loop configuration whose exit is the completed-loop anchor if the simulated machine is still running and the escape anchor if it has halted, with tape content $ct'$, tag $b'$, input position $p$, and the given output prefix. At every earlier time $u<T$, its state is neither exit anchor with either tag.
